description:
We are a dedicated 5-member team (Data Science, Backend, UI/UX, Business Analysis, Engineering & Presentation) tackling the "Planet X and SPHEREx" challenge.

Our project, SPHEREx-EYE, is an AI-powered platform processing SPHEREx’s 102-band infrared data to detect Planet X, asteroids, and celestial anomalies in seconds. We combine deep learning, backend architecture, and UI design to deliver an interactive NASA-level solution for space exploration and citizen science.
